scene: Standing facing the viewer beside a small telescope on an empty rooftop observatory at clear midnight, one relaxed hand adjusting its focusing wheel, the other open on a separate tripod strut. Complete head, both hands and shoes in frame, starlit navy sky and soft cool roof lighting, no written star charts.
outfit: Opaque navy sleeveless cropped mock-neck knit top, high-waisted white tailored wide-leg trousers, silver flat sandals and tiny blue droplet stud earrings. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff with secure chest and pelvis coverage; ordinary astronomy hobby clothing, no armor.
